title: Rhaly-Type Operators in Several Complex Variables
summary: Recently, a generalization of the Cesàro operator to several variables was introduced as a tuple acting on the Drury-Arveson space \cite{P}. We determine the norm of these Cesàro-type operators and utilize it along with this Cesàro tuple definition to generalize the classical Rhaly operator and recover some basic facts about this operator when applied to the generalization.
